jobs.title: Program Coordinator II
jobs.description:
**About Abode:**



At **Abode**, we believe everyone deserves a safe and stable place to call home. Our mission is to solve homelessness through housing and supportive services that help individuals and families achieve stability and independence. Grounded in the Housing First model, we meet people where they are and provide individualized support based on their needs, goals, and strengths. When you join Abode, you’re not just taking a job, you’re becoming part of a team creating meaningful change in our communities and a commitment to lasting housing stability.


**Our Values:**



We start with dignity, take smart risks, be transparent, solve for today and tomorrow, and spark each other’s strengths in everything we do!


**The Diverse Culture:**



We believe that we make better decisions and provide quality services when our workforce reflects the diversity of the communities in which we operate. People of color make up nearly 70% of our workforce and we strive to recruit and retain employees from all backgrounds.


**About The Role**: The Program Coordinator will supervise the provision of services to program participants in the County, through direct staff supervision of staff.


**How You Make An Impact**:


* Provide supervision and leadership and supervision to the assigned team.
* Participate in county wide meetings, provide feedback on successes and necessary system re\-designs.
* Engage in on\-going tracking and evaluation of program goals and effectiveness.
* Provide support to staff when dealing with client crises and problem solving with managers on challenging participant situations.
* Provide feedback, coaching training, and disciplinary action as needed.
* Work with staff to ensure in real time and accurate data entry is occurring.
* Work with Data Specialists on reporting to funders and stakeholders on program activities.
* Monitor assigned employee’s contacts with participants to ensure maximization of funding and program deliverables are met.
* Facilitate case conferencing and administrative meetings.
* Develop materials, assessment tools, job descriptions, and other program processes/documents/tools.
* Develop program policy and procedures, services delivery, and other aspects of the program.
* Other duties as assigned.


**How You Meet Qualifications:**


* Bachelor's degree in psychology, Human Services, Social Work, Sociology, or related field, or equivalent experience.
* 3 years of professional experience in the human services, social work, or related field and demonstrated experience working collaboratively with low\-income families.
* 1 year of direct experience in the provision and supervision of services to individuals who are homeless and/or have extremely low incomes.
* Flexible schedule to work evening and weekend hours as needed.
* Use of personal vehicle and proof of a valid and current California Driver’s License and current insurance along with a clean DMV record required.


COMPETENCIES:


* Excellent verbal \& written communication, organizational, and time management skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with meticulous attention to detail.
* Ability to work well independently and collaboratively with teams.
* Strong ability to represent the interests of the agency, interact effectively with a diverse population with multiple special needs, and be comfortable building successful collaborative relationships with tenants, staff, and with community networking and resource building.
* Must have a working knowledge of Psychiatric Disorders.
* Knowledge and ability to implement the following evidence\-based models, Psychosocial Rehabilitation, Harm Reduction, and Motivational Interviewing.
* Experience in building supportive and respectful working relationships with participants and staff.
* Practice and knowledge of culturally sensitive components of direct service delivery through open dialogs and self\-exploration with diverse groups.
* Experienced in effectively intervening in crisis situations using de\-escalation techniques.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office programs, systems, and platforms.
* Ability to learn and use required mobile devices and business\-related applications.
* Outstanding communication skills and high degree of emotional intelligence, cultural humility, with a proven track record to build and maintain effective relationships with a wide variety of internal and external contacts.


**Our Benefits and Perks:**


* **Competitive Pay**: $75,000\.00\-$92,000\.00 (DOE)
* **Classification:** Full Time/Exempt
* **Work Arrangement**: Onsite position; Tuesday through Friday 12:00 PM\- 8:00 PM, Saturday 9\-5
* **PTO**:19 days per year, increasing with tenure
* **Holidays**: 12 paid holidays per year
* **Health \& Wellness**:
	+ 100% medical, dental and vision coverage options for employees
	+ Agency dependent health care contribution
	+ Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
	+ Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
	+ Retirement Plan: 403(b) Plan w/ Employer Match \& Contribution Programs
* **Voluntary Benefits**:
	+ Commuter Assistance
	+ Life Insurance
	+ Legal Services
* **Mission Driven Culture**: Join a team that's passionate about making a meaningful impact in the fight to end homelessness.


**Notice**: This description is to be used as a guide only. It does not constitute a contract, commitment or promise of any kind. Abode Services reserves the right to change, add, delete, upgrade, or downgrade the position as dictated by business necessity at any time with or without notice.


**Notice**: Abode Services is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Drug Free Workplace


#### **Education**


Required* Bachelors or better in Psychology
* Bachelors or better in Human Services

Preferred* Bachelors or better in Sociology

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity
  
We're looking for a Senior Creative Cloud Customer Success Manager to join our Digital Media team. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to drive adoption and value realization across Adobe's Creative Cloud portfolio, build trusted advisor relationships with key customer collaborators, and deliver presentations that generate excitement and interest from power users to the C\-suite.
  
  

What You'll Do
  
Own the customer relationship end\-to\-end, with accountability for activation, adoption, engagement, expansion, and health scores
  
Guide customers through implementation and onboarding, ensuring they hit their goals and get maximum value from the product
  
Position Adobe's full Creative Cloud portfolio — core creative applications, Firefly, Frame.io, and Adobe Express — in ways that connect directly to customer goals and business outcomes
  
Maintain deep product expertise and serve as a trusted advisor, including through executive presentations and point\-of\-view documents
  
Partner with Account Managers, Sales Specialists, Solutions Consultants, and Product Marketing to drive successful launches, identify growth opportunities, and expand accounts
  
Identify accounts with deployment risk and collaborate across the sales team to build and implement remediation plans
  
  

Capture customer feedback, identify trends, and surface actionable insights to product and marketing teams
  
  

What You Need to Succeed
  
5\+ years in customer success, sales, or solutions consulting, ideally in creative or technology industries
  
Track record of hitting customer success metrics or sales quota, and navigating complex customer challenges to resolution
  
A creative mentality, whether thats through creative expression or a sense of curiosity and desire to improve products, processes, or experiences
  
Familiarity with creative software — Creative Cloud, Canva, Figma, or similar — is a plus
  
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

**Resourceful:** able to prioritize, handle ambiguity, and operate independently

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Why Achira**
==============

* Join a world\-class team of scientists, researchers, and entrepreneurs building the future of drug discovery.
* Partner with leadership to shape how a fast\-growing company operates day\-to\-day.
* Build and scale foundational HR systems, processes, and culture in a high\-growth environment.
* Operate with trust, ownership, and transparency in a mission\-driven company advancing science and technology.

**About the Role**
==================


Achira is seeking an experienced, people\-focused operations Manager to lead the people team for an early\-stage, high\-growth start\-up. This role oversees the full employee experience from recruiting and onboarding to performance management, employee relations, and compliance while helping shape a positive, productive workplace culture. The ideal candidate is a strategic leadership partner as well as a trusted resource for employees at every level.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Manage full\-cycle recruiting: job postings, recruiter relations, interviews, reference checks, and offer negotiation
* Oversee onboarding and offboarding processes to ensure smooth employee transitions
* Develop and administer HR policies, ensuring compliance with federal, state, and local employment laws
* Manage employee relations issues, including conflict resolution, disciplinary actions, and investigations
* Lead performance management processes, including reviews, goal\-setting, and improvement plans in collaboration with leadership
* Administer compensation and benefits programs, including open enrollment and annual review cycles
* Partner with team leads and project mgmt. on workforce planning, org design, and headcount needs
* Maintain and improve HR systems (HRIS), records, and reporting in coordination with third party vendor support
* Engage with legal counsel on immigration issues and visa processing ultimately shifting to in\-house processes
* Drive employee engagement initiatives and culture\-building programs in partnership with leadership
* Manage training and professional development programs in partnership with leadership
* Ensure health, safety, and compliance standards are met across the organization
* Prepare HR metrics and reports for leadership (turnover, retention, headcount, etc.)
* Oversee compliance associated with benefit plans and employee policies
* Flexibility in covering administrative responsibilities outside of HR

**About you**
=============

* Bachelor's degree
* 5\+ years of progressive HR experience, including 2\+ years in a management or supervisory capacity
* Strong knowledge of employment law, state requirements, HR best practices, and compliance requirements
* Experience with HRIS platforms (e.g., Workday, ADP, or similar)
* Excellent interpersonal, conflict\-resolution, and communication skills
* Proven ability to handle confidential information with discretion
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* SHRM\-CP, SHRM\-SCP, PHR, or SPHR certification preferred
* Highly organized and detail\-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and keep operations running smoothly
* Strong problem\-solver who is proactive, resourceful, and able to act independently
* Excellent interpersonal skills; you create a positive, welcoming environment and communicate effectively across teams
* Comfortable with basic tools (Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, etc.) and not afraid to learn new skills
* Hands\-on and adaptable — excited to roll up your sleeves and build processes in a fast\-paced, evolving environment
* Mission\-driven and motivated to support a team advancing drug discovery
* Experience in managing employees in science, technology, or research fields
* Commitment to equity and employee engagement
* Experience supporting a distributed or hybrid workforce
* Data\-driven approach to HR decision\-making


Compensation Range: $125K \- $175K

jobs.title: Office Manager, San Francisco
jobs.description:
Apollo.io is the leading go\-to\-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1\.6 billion. Apollo.io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo.io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top\-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

**About the Role**
------------------



Apollo is opening a new office in San Francisco, and we're looking for an Office Manager to own the day\-to\-day operations of the space. Reporting to the Chief of Staff, this person will make sure the office is safe, welcoming, and productive, from front\-of\-house hospitality to vendor coordination to onboarding logistics.



This role is about more than keeping the lights on. You will bring structure and follow\-through to a growing office, working closely with the Chief of Staff, IT Team, and People Team to keep operations running smoothly as the team scales. You will set the tone for anyone who walks through the door, whether that is a new hire on day one or a visiting executive.



The ideal candidate is proactive, detail oriented, and genuinely enjoys creating a great workplace experience. You are just as comfortable managing vendors and logistics as you are greeting a visitor with a warm welcome.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


### **Office Operations \& Vendor Management**


* Support the day\-to\-day operations of the office environment to ensure it remains safe, welcoming, and productive.
* Collaborate with the Chief of Staff to implement office policies, coordinate logistics, and support company initiatives.
* Coordinate with building management and approved vendors, including maintenance, cleaning, snacks, and supplies, under guidance from the Chief of Staff.
* Maintain inventory of office supplies and oversee restocking of all common areas.
* Report and follow up on facility maintenance issues, working closely with building management and approved vendors. Obtain a minimum of three invoices or quotes per service, per policy.
* Coordinate vendors and contractors end to end: schedule the work, follow through, and catch issues before they become visible problems.

### **Workplace Experience, Onboarding \& Events**


* Greet visitors and ensure a smooth check\-in experience that reflects Apollo's brand and hospitality standards.
* Manage badge and access administration, including access for visitors, card deactivation, and a monthly review of active access cards.
* Own onsite onboarding activities and office onboarding logistics in collaboration with IT and People Ops, including welcome and orientation touchpoints.
* Help coordinate in\-office events, employee recognition moments, and team gatherings with direction from the Chief of Staff.
* Maintain organization and daily presentation of communal spaces such as kitchens, conference rooms, and shared desks.

### **Health, Safety \& Compliance**


* Assist in safety procedures and help coordinate office readiness, such as fire drills and ergonomic checks.
* Ensure signage, office protocols, and emergency materials are maintained and up to date.
* Act as a point of contact during minor incidents or office\-related disruptions, escalating appropriately to building management and leadership.
* Work closely with Apollo's safety and compliance stakeholders on any office\-related safety requests.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------



In this role, success means:


* The office runs smoothly day to day, and issues are resolved before they become disruptions.
* Vendors and building management are handled proactively, with clear documentation and cost discipline.
* New hires have a welcoming first day, and visitors leave with a strong impression of Apollo.
* The Chief of Staff, IT, and People Team all consider this person a reliable partner.
* Office events and team moments feel organized and well executed.
* Safety protocols and compliance requirements are consistently met.

**What You Bring**
------------------


* 3 to 5 years of experience in administrative, office management, workplace operations, hospitality, or facilities coordination roles.
* Experience supporting an in\-office team in a startup or corporate environment.
* **Organization:** Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to juggle multiple requests at once.
* **Communication:** Clear, friendly communication style, written and verbal, with a service\-oriented, hospitality mindset.
* **Follow\-through:** Proven ability to follow processes, stay on top of logistical details, and own assigned responsibilities.
* **Vendor management:** Working knowledge of vendor coordination, invoices, and budget review.
* Comfortable using tools such as Google Workspace, Slack, calendar management software, and ticketing or help desk platforms.
* Comfortable using AI tools to boost day\-to\-day productivity, such as drafting and summarizing, and able to critically assess AI\-generated content.
* Full\-time, on\-site availability in San Francisco, five days a week.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**
---------------------------



You may be a strong fit if you are:


* Someone who sets a warm, professional tone for anyone entering the office.
* Proactive and solutions\-focused, comfortable anticipating needs in a fast\-paced, changing environment.

jobs.title: Senior Operations Manager, Implementation & Accounts - Hospital Billing
jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.


Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”


Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.


The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.

**About the Role**
------------------


Commure's RCM product grew up serving outpatient and ambulatory practices. We're now taking it into hospitals, and that's a different job: dozens of tax IDs, several EHRs, a revenue integrity team that tests you in week one, a CFO who wants a number by Friday. This role is the first hire on the Hospital Billing team, the function we're standing up this year to run those launches.


You'll own hospitals launches end to end, building the process while you're running it. Most roles at this level hand you a playbook. In this one you write it.


You won't do it alone. In addition to deep cross\-functional collaboration across Product, Eng, Operations, Sales, and Account Management teams you will work directly with the Hospital Billing GM to define and execute the critical business processes that are required to launch Commure’s largest and most complex customers. If you're coming from an implementation role elsewhere, the difference in scope is real: you keep the account and the number after go\-live.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own hospital launches end to end, from contract signature through stabilized production billing, as the named point of contact for the account
* Build the hospital launch playbook as you go: diligence playbooks, customer management workflows, detailed rule creation and configuration, and the automation needed to run it, none of which exists yet for hospital billing
* Work directly with a customer’s leadership and operations teams to translate enterprise complexity (multiple tax IDs, multiple EHRs, institutional adjudication rules) into smoothly executed implementation plans
* Coordinate daily with Commure's implementation, product, and payer enrollment teams so no account is carried solo
* Own the account after go\-live, driving stable and repeatable collections before transitioning the account to long term management
* Establish clear SLAs and a clean handoff process with the internal teams we partner with to power successful launches
* Help define what Launch and Account Management look like as separate functions within Hospital Billing as the team grows

**What You Have**
-----------------

* 6\+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, or operations at a fast\-paced SaaS tech company
* A demonstrated history of creating opportunities for yourself and seeking ownership positions
* Comfortable working with data; proficiency in SQL and Excel. SQL or a robust analytical background (finance, consulting) is a plus
* Expertise in project management: you've deployed multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable building process without a playbook: you're not looking for a role where the steps are already written down
* Project confidence: you can run a meeting with a health system CFO or revenue integrity team and hold your own on a hard subject
* Confident with ambiguity: you're autonomous, you prioritize well, and you spot blockers before they become escalations
* Energized by people, relentless about finding the truth in a customer's ask rather than the easy answer
* Healthcare or RCM experience is a plus, not a filter.


Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. jobs.description:
Strategy \& Operations \- San Francisco

  


**About the Team**


OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general\-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity.


The Business Marketing team contributes to our broader mission of ensuring responsible and widespread adoption of artificial intelligence by developing and executing strategies that drive awareness amongst core business audiences.


The Strategy \& Operations function supports Business Marketing with operating models and cadences; strategic planning; portfolio, resource, and investment management; measurement and organizational learning that empower our teams to move at pace with clarity and confidence.


**About the Role**


We’re looking for a resourcefuling marketing campaigns. You’ll manage our marketing portfolio and intake process, lead selected cross\-functional projects, and build AI\-enabled tools that make it easier for marketers to get their work done.


You’ll be the first partner for new requests: understanding the business need, sizing the work, and finding its best home. You’ll connect requests to existing campaigns and programs where possible, establish clear ownership, and make sure teams have the context and structure they need to move quickly.


This role combines an integrated marketing mindset with hands\-on project management and a builder’s instinct. You should enjoy being the person everyone reaches out to, making sense of ambiguity, and seeing how a small ask might become a much bigger thing—or when a big ask is actually something quite small. This role makes everyone’s life a little easier by providing a better understanding of what’s happening across the entire department, a clear way to kick off work with the right people, high\-touch support for our most intense projects, and useful systems that take friction out of everyone’s day.


**In this role, you will:**
---------------------------


* **Lead selected cross\-functional projects.** Build the model by program\-managing some of our biggest the process.
* **Run marketing intake and triage.** Clarify the audiences. Find a path to “yes, we can” for most requests, and feel comfortable telling a stakeholder “why not” if that’s truly the best answer.
* **Manage the ongoing marketing portfolio.** Maintain a clear view of active and upcoming work. Use your deep knowledge of the portfolio—including team members’ responsibilities and availability—to push for single\-threaded, named leadership when there are multiple contributors.
* **Find the right home for the work.** Determine whether a request belongs within an existing campaign, needs integrated marketing involvement, warrants a standalone project, or can be handled through self\-service. Understand that every request is important for some reason and treat it as such, while still making recommendations grounded in business priorities.
* **Set projects up for effective collaboration.** Create clarity by naming accountable ownersation structure. Use AI workflows to kick off briefs and project spaces and appropriately capture status updates and decision records.
* **Partner closely with Creative Operations.** Bring creative partners in early to help shape briefs and assess feasibility and production needs. Ensure Creative Operations has what it needs to assign creative staff, estimate capacity, scope agency agreements, and create production timelines.
* **Build and improve AI\-enabled tools and workflows.** Personally prototype and implement practical ways to improve intake, brief development, project setup, portfolio visibility, and reporting. Test with users, maintain appropriate human review, and improve what actually saves people time.
* **Make the operating model easier to use.** Use team feedback and delivery patterns to simplify processes, strengthen self\-service, and reduce repetitive coordination. Build systems that remain useful as the team and volume of work grow.

**You might thrive in this role, if you have:**
-----------------------------------------------


* 7\+ years of experience in marketing program and project management, integrated marketing management, or marketing portfolio management across multiple teams and concurrent priorities.
* A track record of personally leading cross\-functional projects, establishing ownership, managing dependencies, and driving work through to completion.
* An integrated marketing mindset: you see beyond an individual deliverable to understand its audience, purpose, campaign context, and relationship to other work.
* Strong judgment in ambiguous situationsation.
* Experience designing intake processes, project structures, and portfolio systems that people adopt and prefer to use because they make their lives easier.
* Hands\-on experience building AI\-enabled tools, automations, or workflows, with concrete examples of how they improved work. You can move from identifying a problem to testing and implementing a useful solution.
* The ability to build trust with marketers, creatives, and operational partners, including when you need to challenge an ask, reset expectations, or recommend a different path.
* A consulting\-like approach to problem\-solving: curiosity, structured thinking, comfort with unfamiliar problems, and a willingness to do hands\-on work.
* A bias toward simplicity and sustainable execution. You create clarity and momentum without adding meetings, processes, or maintenance that outweigh their value.

AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

**Job Description**


HPE’s acquisition of Juniper Networks is one of the most significant moves in the company’s history, bringing two networking leaders together to build HPE Networking, with the ambition of creating the best networking business on the planet. This role sits at the center of that effort as part of the Lead\-to\-Cash (L2C) program, responsible for unifying quoting, ordering, and fulfillment across the combined HPE and Juniper networking portfolios onto a single platform, replacing fragmented legacy systems with one seamless, scalable experience for sellers, partners, and customers worldwide.


As part of a fast\-moving, multi\-year transformation, the team will stabilize near\-term operations, migrate core platforms, onboard businesses and suppliers globally, and build new capabilities from the ground up. The choices made here will shape how the combined networking business operates for years to come. You will work closely with business leaders, IT architects, suppliers, and partner stakeholders on a program with direct executive visibility, solving integration challenges at a scale few companies ever attempt.


For the right person, this is a rare opportunity to help build a new business unit from its earliest days, rather than inherit someone else’s systems. You will gain hands\-on exposure to enterprise\-scale platform integration and cross\-functional program leadership, with the kind of complexity and pace that can accelerate your career. ### **Join our Mission to Protect Humankind!**


Vaxcyte is a clinical\-stage vaccine innovation company engineering high\-fidelity vaccines to protect humankind from the consequences of bacterial diseases, which have serious and costly health consequences when left unchecked. Working to eradicate or treat bacterial infections such as invasive pneumococcal disease, Group A Strep, and Shigella is just the beginning. Our path to success is clear and well\-defined, and Vaxcyte is set up to go the distance.

**WHAT** we do is every bit as important as **HOW** we do it! Our work together is guided by four enduring core values:

* RETHINK CONVENTION: We bring creative and intellectual diversity to every facet of the work we do in order to innovate and re\-innovate the way vaccines are delivered.



* AIM HIGH: We embody our collectively audacious goal to courageously make the most complex biologics ever attempted to protect humankind.



* LEAD WITH HEART: Everyone leads at Vaxcyte with a kindness\-first, inclusive approach to collaboration and vigorous debate that advances our business objectives.



* MODEL EXCELLENCE: The magnitude of our challenge requires our shared commitment to demonstrating integrity, accountability, equality and clarity across communications and decision making.

Vaxcyte is seeking a Commercial Project Manager to join the IT Project Management team and support commercial launch readiness. In partnership with the Commercial Launch Lead and cross\-functional stakeholders, this role will own key project management deliverables, including the integrated launch schedule, critical path, meeting governance, risk log, dashboards, status reporting, and communications. **Job Category:** Project / Program Management
  
**Job Level:** Individual Contributor
  
**Business Unit:** Energy Delivery
  
**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Pleasanton; San Ramon
  
  

Department Overview
  
  

Gas Engineering is focused on ensuring the safe and reliable flow of natural gas to our customers. As a part of Gas Engineering, the Gas Transmission Engineering and Design group (GTED) focuses on providing the technical direction and design of gas transmission pipeline and facility projects, and supporting the execution of the work in the field. The group also provides technical review and approval of project documentation post construction to ensure company records are updated accurately and reflect the scope of work performed. The Materials Management team within GTED is responsible for supporting project material needs, and ensuring traceable, verifiable, and complete (TVC) records are available for the materials we install per federal code requirements.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

This Expert Gas Program Manager position provides strategic leadership and oversight for materials traceability and materials management within PG\&E’s Gas Engineering team, supporting both transmission and distribution systems. This role is responsible for ensuring that all gas\-related materials are fully traceable, compliant, and aligned with federal, state, and corporate regulatory requirements.
  
  

This position operates at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, quality, and field execution, driving enterprise\-wide process improvements, strengthening data governance, and ensuring audit readiness. The role also plays a key part in advancing material lifecycle management, improving project visibility, and delivering measurable cost and operational efficiencies.
  
  

**Key Job Duties:**  

Materials Traceability \& Regulatory Compliance
  
* Lead centralized intake and resolution of material traceability inquiries supporting gas transmission and distribution projects.
* Conduct advanced research and documentation retrieval across SAP, vendor databases, and internal systems to validate traceability in accordance with PHMSA and PG\&E standards.
* Ensure all materials are traceable, verifiable, complete, and auditable, supporting safe field execution and public safety.
* Partner with Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA), Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE), manufacturers, and vendors to resolve documentation gaps and validate material quality.
* Drive enhancements to traceability processes, including SAP data entry, logging, and validation controls to improve accuracy and audit readiness.
* Support and lead regulatory audit responses, including CPUC and PHMSA\-related initiatives.


Materials Management \& Process Controls
  
* Lead development and implementation of materials management processes, including material ordering workflows, BOM standardization, and SAP data governance.
* Oversee material tracking systems to provide end\-to\-end visibility into material status, shortages, and project readiness.
* Manage inventory lifecycle activities, including reallocation of surplus materials, resolution of aged inventory, and optimization of material utilization.
* Establish and manage centralized materials intake processes to ensure consistent tracking, accountability, and responsiveness.

**A Brief Overview**  

Stanford Health Care's Enterprise Contact Center (ECC) serves as a shared services platform supporting patient scheduling, nurse triage, referral coordination, and multi\-specialty contact center operations across the SHC care delivery network. The CRM Program Manager owns the Epic CRM program for the enterprise contact center ecosystem — the taxonomy, standards, governance, and operational workflows that determine how every patient contact is categorized, routed, documented, and reported. Business requirements, workflow validation, UAT, and operational sign\-off are owned by this role; Epic/TDS teams own technical build, configuration, functional testing, and integration testing.

Stanford Health Care

* Owns the Epic CRM program including taxonomy, standards, foundational structure, and governance to ensure consistency across ECC and non\-ECC contact center teams.

* Serves as the single business owner of the CRM data model — defining and enforcing the hierarchy of contact types, categories, subcategories, dispositions, and follow\-up actions that agents select to classify every patient interaction across the enterprise, ensuring the taxonomy supports cascading navigation and consistent disposition selection.

* Leads User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for CRM workflow changes prior to deployment, validating that business requirements are met and operational workflows perform as expected; functional testing, configuration testing, and integration testing are owned by Epic/TDS technical teams.
* Knowledge Base Alignment \& Content Governance
* Ensures CRM follow\-up actions, dispositions, and next steps are appropriately classified and aligned with Panviva knowledge base content so that guidance remains intuitive, duplication is minimized, and staff receive a consistent experience across systems.
* Partners with the knowledge management team to maintain a mapping between CRM disposition codes and corresponding Panviva articles — ensuring that when an agent selects a disposition, the relevant guidance surfaces automatically.
* Identifies and remediates content drift: cases where CRM workflow changes have made knowledge base articles stale, or where new knowledge base content requires corresponding CRM taxonomy updates.
* Supports the transition from Panviva to any future knowledge management platform (e.g., CXone Expert, Genesys Knowledge) by ensuring CRM\-to\-KB mappings are documented and portable.

* Partners with Epic, TDS, operations, PMO, and other stakeholders to evaluate CRM\-related requests, define business requirements, and assess downstream impact prior to implementation.
* Establishes a CRM change advisory process: no CRM taxonomy or workflow change goes to production without documented impact assessment covering routing, reporting, KB alignment, and agent experience.
* Owns the end\-to\-end operational change management for omnichannel CTI and Epic CRM rollout, ensuring workflows, documentation standards, staff readiness, and adoption are implemented in a coordinated manner.
* Develops and delivers CRM\-specific training for new agents, supervisors, and operational leads — not just how to use the system, but why the taxonomy matters and how their inputs drive downstream reporting and patient experience.

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.
  
  

We invite applicants who are inspired by our Principles of Community and who are eager to be part of our exciting Strategic Plan , which charts Berkeley's next era of excellence.
  
  

Learn more about some of our accomplishments at Points of Pride .
  
  

Departmental Overview
  
  

The Basic Needs Center supports students with food, housing, and financial stability resources, and connects students to other essential services. Support includes assessment of individualized student needs, navigation of and connection to basic needs resources, and planning and support to address students' immediate and long\-term care in collaboration with on and off campus partners and services.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

The Basic Needs Intake Coordinator serves as a primary point of contact for students engaging with the Basic Needs Center's (BNC) direct student support systems. This position plays a vital role in ensuring that students are triaged and connected efficiently to holistic services, including food, housing, and financial stability resources. The Intake Coordinator supports the initial assessment process, assists with case coordination and administration, manages a portfolio of standard resource requests, and contributes to the daily operations of the center's public\-facing services.
  
  

Application Review Date
  
  

The First Review Date for this job is September 24, 2026\. For full consideration, please apply on or before the first review date.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
  

Assessment and Triage \- 30%
  
  

**Initial Screening:** Serve as a central point of contact for student inquiries and referrals; conduct foundational reviews to identify student needs, urgency, and appropriate pathways for support.
  
**Service Routing:** Determine appropriate next steps for incoming requests, including routing to case management staff, providing immediate resource navigation, or referring to campus and community partners.
  
**Trend Monitoring:** Assist in tracking engagement data and service trends to help leadership evaluate service demands and emerging student needs.
  
  

Case Coordination and Administration \- 30%
  
  

**Queue Management:** Support the administration of the case referral queue, assisting with the timely and equitable distribution of workflows among the support team.
  
**Documentation \& Systems:** Maintain accurate, confidential records within the department's data management systems to ensure seamless transitions and continuity of care.
  
**Internal Communication:** Facilitate communication between triage entry points and service providers to ensure dependable handoffs and follow\-up tracking.
  
**Workflow Optimization:** Participate in the ongoing review and refinement of administrative workflows to maximize service efficiency and team responsiveness.
  
  

Resource Navigation and Direct Support \- 25%
  
  

**Standard Support Portfolio:** Provide short\-term, solution\-focused coordination for students navigating standard or transactional resource requests (e.g., emergency financial applications, basic resource navigation, and public benefit program guidance).
  
**Follow\-Up Coordination:** Conduct routine follow\-up communications with students to confirm resolution of immediate needs and verify connection to external resources.
  
  

Center Operations and Programmatic Support \- 15%
  
  

**In\-Person Services:** Support the center's public\-facing and in\-person operations, ensuring a welcoming, organized, and accessible environment for the campus community.
  
**Outreach \& Engagement:** Participate in center\-wide outreach efforts and programs as needed.
  
**Special Projects:** Assist with general projects and data collection efforts in alignment with broader center goals and operational needs.
  
  

Required Qualifications
  
  

At least 2 years of experience providing direct support or case management in a social services, educational, or community\-based setting.
  
Advanced knowledge of advising and counseling techniques, including crisis interventions.
  
Advanced knowledge of principles and procedures involved in risk assessment and planning.
  
Advanced knowledge of trauma\-informed assessment \& intervention.
  
Advanced organizational and communication skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple demands.
  
Advanced skill in judgment and decision\-making, problem solving, identifying measures of system performance.
  
Demonstrated emotional intelligence and agility necessary to address the complex needs of diverse students, staff, and community partners.
  
  

Education / Training
  
  

Bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, education, higher education administration, higher education counseling or a related field and/or equivalent training or experience. (Required)

jobs.description:
**This position is 100% in office!!!**

At **Muir Home Health** , we believe that home healthcare is more than just a service – it’s a commitment to enhancing the quality of life of every individual we serve. Nestled in the heart of the vibrant East Bay area of California, we are on a mission to revolutionize the way home health is perceived and delivered.


**Muir Home Health is growing and looking for an experienced and compassionate Scheduling/Intake Coordinator to join our team!** As a scheduling/intake coordinator with Muir Home Health, you will have the opportunity to advance your career while receiving strong compensation and excellent benefits.


**BENEFITS**

* Competitive compensation
* Health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
* 401(k) plan with generous company match
* Critical illness benefit
* Paid time off
* Employee assistance program

**Pay Range:** $24\.00 \- $34\.00/hr


**Job Type:** Full Time


**JOB SUMMARY**

The Intake Coordinator/Scheduler is responsible for managing all aspects of the patient intake and staffing processes to support the operations of the Home Health Agency. This role serves as a central point of coordination, communicating directly with patients, families, referral sources, and internal staff to ensure seamless delivery of services.


Key responsibilities include overseeing patient intake, performing data entry, verifying insurance and obtaining authorizations, and facilitating daily intake stand\-up meetings. The coordinator also manages clinician scheduling and workflow completion in Home Care Home Base, ensuring accurate alignment of patient needs with staff availability.


This position requires building and maintaining positive relationships with patients, families, clinical field staff, contract staff, and referral sources, while proactively responding to inquiries, resolving concerns, and maintaining accurate information to support efficient coordination of patient care services.


**DUTIES AND RESPSONSIBILITY**

* Direct and manage all daily patient referral, intake, and scheduling operations, including oversight of intake policies, procedures, and workflow efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with all state, federal, Medicare, and Joint Commission regulatory requirements related to intake, scheduling, and service delivery.
* Coordinate seamless patient transitions to home care by overseeing patient intake, education, plan of care initiation, and collaboration with multiple service providers.
* Verify insurance coverage, obtain authorizations, and support maximum third\-party reimbursement, including negotiating service pricing within established guidelines.
* Manage clinician scheduling and staffing processes by maintaining accurate data on staff demographics, skill sets, availability, and productivity levels to align patient needs with appropriate resources.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for inbound calls, responding promptly and professionally to patient, staff, and referral source inquiries and concerns.
* Establish and maintain strong relationships with referral sources, patients, families, clinical staff, contract staff, and internal teams to support coordinated care delivery.
* Facilitate daily intake or staffing stand\-up meetings and support clinical leadership by maintaining proper workflow and prioritization of tasks.
* Accurately complete and manage all scheduling\-related workflows, including new referrals, missed visits, visit adjustments, recertifications, caseload reassignments, and staffing changes.
* Assist the Intake team by providing staffing solutions for new patient referrals and identifying needs for additional staff resources.
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of contractual relationships with payers and contract staff, ensuring adherence to contract provisions and service requirements.
* Monitor, gather, and report referral and staffing metrics, including trends, productivity, and performance indicators.
* Support administrative functions for clinical and marketing teams and contribute to maintaining a high\-quality reputation within the community.
* Assist leadership with budget planning, resource allocation, and continuous process improvement initiatives.
* Demonstrate professionalism, accountability, and commitment to ongoing growth and competency development.

**BENEFITS**

* Competitive compensation
* Health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance
* 401(k) plan with generous company match
* Critical illness benefit
* Paid time off
* Employee assistance program
**WHY MUIR HOME HEALTH?**

Muir Home Health **is part of the Cornerstone Group** with about 75 home health and hospice agencies throughout the country. **While we are part of a large family, we operate as a local team.** We understand we are nothing without great employees! It is through our team’s dedication to deliver life changing service that we become the “provider of choice” in the community that we serve. **Join a culture of high performers** who are on a mission to create the best Home Health agency in the East Bay!


**What makes us unique?** At Muir Home Health, we foster an environment where clinicians and staff members have an unprecedented level of freedom to create and implement the programs that will best serve their patients and communities. We operate with the Core Values of CAPLICO in mind:


* Celebration
* Accountability
* Passion for Learning
* Love One Another
* Intelligent Risk Taking
* Customer Second
* Ownership

We’d love to meet with you if you are passionate about giving exceptional patient care and creating the best Home Health agency in the East Bay!


*Muir Home Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.*

jobs.description:
Your Role:


This position provides quality assurance oversight for cGMP manufacturing of advanced cell and gene therapy products. Ensures strict compliance with FDA, EMA, ISO and other applicable regulations through real\-time shop\-floor support, batch record review, and disposition of raw materials and final drug products. This position also supports the implementation of the quality systems in compliance with cGMPs and other company policies.



Essential Duties and Responsibilities:


* Perform review of batch records for intermediate or final product, cell banks including in\-process testing, QC release testing data packages, labeling, packaging, and all supporting documentation
* Inspect, review, and disposition raw materials, reagents and components
* Facilitate investigations relating to manufactured products and raw materials
* Provide QA oversight and QA on the floor support during GMP manufacturing operations
* Conduct line clearances, in\-process inspections, support final product packaging operations, etc.
* Assist cross\-functional teams with the initiation, investigation, and approval of Change Controls, Deviations, and CAPAs, providing critical QA input throughout.
* Create, review and revise standard operating procedures, study protocols, reports, and other GxP documents as needed.
* Coordinate the release of final cell\-based therapeutic products for clinical and commercial applications.
* Participate in audit of internal departments, external clients, suppliers, and service providers and completion of audit reports as needed.
* Review and approve validation and qualification packages including installation, operation, and performance qualifications (IQ, OQ, PQ) protocols and reports as necessary.
* Train and provide QA guidance to internal functional groups on Quality Systems.
* Provide environmental monitoring support as needed.
* Participate in internal and client facing meetings as needed.
* 8:00am to 5:00pm with irregular hours/weekends/nights.
* Other duties as assigned


Requirements:


* Bachelor’s degree in life science; 5\+ years of direct QA experience related to GMP Manufacturing in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry.
* Experience in cell\-based therapeutics or biopharmaceuticals preferred.
* Experience working with Quality Systems, writing deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls.
* Experience in supporting/assisting the internal and external audits, inspections.


 Knowledge / Skills / Abilities:


* Strong knowledge of cGMPs and FDA, EMA, ICH, and ISO regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of Quality Systems, including Deviations, CAPAs, Change Controls, document control, and training processes.

* Strong investigation, problem\-solving, and risk assessment skills.
* Strong technical writing, document review, and communication skills.
* Ability to provide QA oversight in a GMP manufacturing environment.

Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus. jobs.title: Contingent Worker Program Manager (Contract)
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.


We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.


We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.


If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About the Role:**


We're looking for a Contingent Worker Program Manager to build our contingent workforce program from the ground up. This is a foundational role: you'll assess our current policies and practices, identify risk areas, and design the frameworks, processes, and SOPs that will govern how we engage, onboard, and manage contingent workers as we scale. Your work will directly shape how the company manages compliance risk, cost, and operational efficiency across a growing contingent workforce.


The ideal candidate has deep, hands\-on experience standing up or overhauling contingent workforce programs in a high\-growth environment, is comfortable operating with significant ambiguity, and can move fluidly between strategic program design and day\-to\-day operational execution. This is a contract position, ideal for someone who thrives on building programs from scratch and can hit the ground running with minimal ramp\-up time.

**What You'll Be Working On:**

* **Policy Review \& Redesign:** Audit our current contingent worker policies and practices, identifying gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* **Program Build:** Design and implement a comprehensive contingent worker program from the ground up, including governance, classification guidelines, and engagement workflows.
* **Risk Assessment:** Evaluate current practices for compliance, misclassification, and operational risk, and recommend mitigation strategies.
* **SOP Development:** Build clear, scalable standard operating procedures for contingent worker intake, onboarding, and offboarding.
* **Onboarding \& Offboarding Management :** Own and improve the end\-to\-end onboarding experience for contingent workers, ensuring consistency and compliance.
* **Procurement Partnership:** Partner closely with Procurement to align on vendor management, statement\-of\-work processes, and contingent labor spend.
* **Day\-to\-Day Operations:** Manage ongoing operational duties related to contingent worker requests, approvals, and system tracking.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:** Work cross\-functionally with Legal, HR, Finance, and hiring managers to ensure the program meets business and compliance needs.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* 5\+ years of experience managing contingent workforce, vendor management, or contractor/staffing programs.
* Demonstrated experience building or significantly overhauling a contingent worker program, ideally within a high\-growth company.
* Strong understanding of worker classification, compliance risk, and contingent labor best practices.
* Proven experience partnering with Procurement on vendor and statement\-of\-work processes.
* Hands\-on experience developing SOPs and operational documentation.
* Strong project management skills with the ability to balance strategic design work with daily operational demands.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across HR, Legal, Finance, and business teams.

**Bonus Points**

* Experience with VMS (Vendor Management System) platforms
* Background in a legal, compliance, or risk\-focused function related to contingent labor.
* Experience working in a fast\-scaling startup or tech company.
* Familiarity with global contingent workforce considerations (if applicable to the business).

jobs.title: Clinical Study Program Manager
jobs.description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  

The Position
  
  

Clinical Study Program Manager \- Santa Clara, CA
  
A healthier future. It is what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come. Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love.
  
  

The Opportunity
  
The Clinical Study Program Manager will direct multiple moderate to complex exploratory research and clinical projects from study initiation through contract completion in our Personalized Healthcare Solutions (PHCS) division. Studies will be conducted within our Roche Molecular CAP/CLIA laboratory and/or through designated research laboratories and will support the efforts of Pharma Services overall. The role requires solid project management, leadership skills and experience in delivering projects on time, within budget. and with high customer satisfaction. This role collaborates closely with cross\-functional teams at leadership and supporting levels, playing a critical part in both the short\-term success of the Pharma Services business and the long\-term direction of Roche's Molecular Laboratories.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Project\& Strategy Execution: Develops cross\-functional project plans, timelines, and budgets to deliver clinical study collaborations on schedule and within financial targets.
* Portfolio\& Risk Management: Leads joint project meetings, tracks portfolio performance through dashboards, and proactively resolves complex risks with scalable solutions.
* Team Leadership: Manages a team of clinical study project managers, offering clear direction, mentorship, and day\-to\-day operational guidance.
* Client\& Stakeholder Communication: Serves as the primary contact for Pharma and client partners, delivering regular status updates, financial reporting, and invoicing management.
* Protocol\& Data Oversight: Directs Clinical Study Protocol execution (IRB submissions, financial tracking) and data management systems, ensuring strict adherence across sites.
* Regulatory Compliance\& Quality: Advises teams on GCP, GDP, and CAP/CLIA regulations, conducting routine quality record reviews and study binder audits alongside QA.
* Process Development: Writes and updates SOPs, sample\-management workflows, and reconciliation plans in partnership with lab leadership to solve complex operational challenges.
* Continuous Improvement: Implements best practices and facilitates knowledge exchange between QA, Business Development, Lab Leadership, and external partners.


**Who You Are:**  

* Bachelor’s degree in medical technology, chemistry, biology or other life sciences


**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Clinical Trial\& Project Leadership: 8–12 years of experience managing projects or clinical trials within a regulated CRO, diagnostic, or pharmaceutical environment.
* Management\& Autonomy: 5\+ years in dedicated project management and 3\+ years managing direct reports, with a proven track record of driving results both independently and cross\-functionally.
* Regulatory\& Lab Compliance Expertise: Deep understanding of CLIA lab operations, CAP/CLIA regulations, and California Business and Professions Code for high\-complexity molecular diagnostics.Hands\-on experience with Laboratory Developed Tests (LDTs) and proficiency in ICH\-GCP, GDPR, CAP, and GCP frameworks highly preferred.
* Technical\& Data Tool Fluency: Proficient with project management platforms, data summary tools, and web\-based applications.
* Communication\& Influence: Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills with a strong ability to manage key stakeholder relationships.


**Location:** Santa Clara, CA \-This position requires regular on\-site presence at the primary location 3 days/week, at minimum.
  
  

Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting.
  
The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location of Santa Clara, CA is $129,600\- $240,800\. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, and other job\-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.
  
Benefits
  
  

Who we are
  
  

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life\-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  

Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  

Roche is an equal opportunity employer. It is our policy and practice to employ, promote, and otherwise treat any and all employees and applicants on the basis of merit, qualifications, and competence. The company's policy prohibits unlawful discrimination, including but not limited to, discrimination on the basis of Protected Veteran status, individuals with disabilities status, and consistent with all federal, state, or local laws.

The Product Risk Program Manager will join the Assurance Assessments within the Product Risk Program Manager team. This role is responsible for assessing risk determinations for their accuracy. More specifically, this role will be responsible for ensuring that approved privacy decisions include all relevant risks and related mitigations. Additionally, the PRPM in this role will help ensure that required mitigations are appropriately implemented. In conducting these reviews and any needed remediations, PRPMs will engage key internal stakeholders including product, engineering, legal, and risk subject matter experts. PRPMs may also need to engage external stakeholders such as an auditor or assessor. A strong candidate for this role will have experience with compliance programs and auditing processes and be able to navigate ambiguity by defining structure, clarifying priorities, and driving progress without complete information.  

  

  

### **Product Risk Program Manager Responsibilities:**

* Establish expertise across a system that’s focused on reviewing and mitigating product risks
* Establish risk expertise across multiple areas including privacy and integrity
* Identify gaps in risk assessments and determinations made by product stakeholders
* Engage cross functional partners and teams including product as needed to finalize assessments about risk determinations
* Able to explain and rationalize compliance and risk decisions to external stakeholders including auditors and assessors
* Track and provide any needed documentation that stems from remediation workflows
* Provide feedback to tooling and platform stakeholders aimed at improving the accuracy and efficiency of the system’s outcomes
* Minimum Qualifications:
* 3\+ years of experience in program management, product operations, trust \& safety, privacy, or legal/compliance environments

  

  

  

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of experience in risk management, program management, compliance, trust and safety, or a related field within a technology or product organization
* Experience conducting structured risk assessments and translating findings into actionable recommendations for product or business stakeholders
* Experience managing cross\-functional programs, including coordinating across legal, policy, engineering, and operations teams to drive alignment and resolution
* Experience developing and maintaining program documentation such as risk registers, playbooks, decision frameworks, or process runbooks
* Experience communicating complex risk topics in writing to both technical and non\-technical audiences, including leadership\-level stakeholders

* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements)

jobs.description:
At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. Our platform spans the full care journey: Ambient AI and Dictation eliminating documentation burden at the point of care, intelligent Agents automating patient and revenue workflows, and autonomous RCM processing billions in claims, all on a single AI\-native platform integrated with 60\+ EHRs.


Healthcare carries a $1 trillion administrative burden and we're at the center of transforming it. Today, 500,000\+ clinicians across 500\+ healthcare organizations nationwide trust Commure to handle $25B\+ in annual claims and support over 200 million patient interactions. Our latest $70M raise at a $7B valuation reflects the confidence the market has placed in this mission. We've also been named to the Fortune Future 50 list and the 2026 AI Breakthrough Awards for “Overall NLP Company of the Year.”


Our team works directly alongside clinicians, not through layers of process, which means the gap between what you build and its impact on patient care is immediate. We move fast, deploy daily, and take full ownership from early thinking to production. If you're energized by hard problems, high stakes, and a team that holds itself to a high bar, you'll find your people here.


The future of healthcare is being built right now. Come deliver this transformation.


**About the Role**
------------------


Commure's RCM product grew up serving outpatient and ambulatory practices. We're now taking it into hospitals, and that's a different job: dozens of tax IDs, several EHRs, a revenue integrity team that tests you in week one, a CFO who wants a number by Friday. This role is the first hire on the Hospital Billing team, the function we're standing up this year to run those launches.


You'll own hospitals launches end to end, building the process while you're running it. Most roles at this level hand you a playbook. In this one you write it.


You won't do it alone. In addition to deep cross\-functional collaboration across Product, Eng, Operations, Sales, and Account Management teams you will work directly with the Hospital Billing GM to define and execute the critical business processes that are required to launch Commure’s largest and most complex customers. If you're coming from an implementation role elsewhere, the difference in scope is real: you keep the account and the number after go\-live.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Own hospital launches end to end, from contract signature through stabilized production billing, as the named point of contact for the account
* Build the hospital launch playbook as you go: diligence playbooks, customer management workflows, detailed rule creation and configuration, and the automation needed to run it, none of which exists yet for hospital billing
* Work directly with a customer’s leadership and operations teams to translate enterprise complexity (multiple tax IDs, multiple EHRs, institutional adjudication rules) into smoothly executed implementation plans
* Coordinate daily with Commure's implementation, product, and payer enrollment teams so no account is carried solo
* Own the account after go\-live, driving stable and repeatable collections before transitioning the account to long term management
* Establish clear SLAs and a clean handoff process with the internal teams we partner with to power successful launches
* Help define what Launch and Account Management look like as separate functions within Hospital Billing as the team grows

**What You Have**
-----------------


* 6\+ years of experience in consulting, investment banking, or operations at a fast\-paced SaaS tech company
* A demonstrated history of creating opportunities for yourself and seeking ownership positions
* Comfortable working with data; proficiency in SQL and Excel. SQL or a robust analytical background (finance, consulting) is a plus
* Expertise in project management: you've deployed multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment
* Comfortable building process without a playbook: you're not looking for a role where the steps are already written down
* Project confidence: you can run a meeting with a health system CFO or revenue integrity team and hold your own on a hard subject
* Confident with ambiguity: you're autonomous, you prioritize well, and you spot blockers before they become escalations
* Energized by people, relentless about finding the truth in a customer's ask rather than the easy answer
* Healthcare or RCM experience is a plus, not a filter.

Please be aware that all official communication from us will come exclusively from email addresses ending in **@****commure.com**. Any emails from other domains are not affiliated with our organization.

Employees will report to the information security office any confirmed or potential events or other risks to the organization. Employees will be required to attest to these requirements upon hire and on an annual basis.

We value humility and believe in direct communication. Our **team is inclusive**, and our differing perspectives allow for better solutions. We are seeking individuals passionate about tackling challenges and are driven by execution. Ready to come find your playground? **Together**, we can help shape the endless possibilities of AI.

 **Role Overview**


d\-Matrix is looking for a Senior HR Generalist with deep compensation and data expertise to help us make sound, defensible pay decisions in a highly competitive market for AI and technical talent. This is an individual contributor role that will own the analytical backbone of our compensation and people data — market benchmarking, salary structures, internal equity, and merit/bonus modeling — while also supporting broader People Operations. This is a hands\-on generalist role rather than a pure Total Rewards specialist position: you'll bring real analytical depth to compensation and reporting and flex into core HR ops work as needed, with complex executive and sales compensation design handled by specialized outside expertise. You'll partner closely with HRBPs, Business Leaders, Talent Acquisition, Global Mobility and Immigration, Employee Relations, and Legal to deliver efficient, data\-informed HR service.

**What You Will Do**

* Lead market benchmarking and survey data analysis to keep salary ranges and job structures competitive and defensible.
* Own job matching and leveling, ensuring consistency and internal equity across the organization.
* Build and maintain compensation models for merit cycles, bonus pools, and promotions, translating data into clear, sound recommendations.
* Support offer construction and internal equity analysis for new hires, promotions, and internal moves, including equity compensation.
* Build and maintain HR reporting and dashboards (e.g., headcount, comp analytics, turnover), using HR data to identify trends, risks, and process gaps.

* Serve as HR systems owner (ADP WFN, Ashby, Lattice), ensuring data accuracy and integrity, and supporting integrations, audits, and troubleshooting.
* Partner cross\-functionally on HR service delivery, and maintain HR policies, procedures, and SOPs in response to regulatory changes.

**What You Will Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
* 5\+ years in HR Operations, with meaningful, hands\-on compensation experience — not limited to participating in an annual comp cycle.
* Direct experience with market benchmarking/survey data, salary structure design, job matching/leveling, internal equity analysis, and merit/bonus modeling.
* Solid understanding of equity compensation.
* Strong Excel and analytical skills, with the ability to build models rather than just interpret them.
* Experience with HRIS/ATS systems (e.g., ADP WFN, Ashby) supporting data\-driven people operations.
