jobs.title: Service Desk Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------


Southern New Hampshire University is a team of innovators. World changers. Individuals who believe in progress with purpose. Since 1932, our people\-centered strategy has defined us — and helped us grow a team that now serves over 180,000 learners worldwide.


Our mission to transform lives is made possible by talented people who bring diverse industry experience, backgrounds and skills to the university. And today, we're ready to expand our reach. All we need is you.


**Make an impact — from near or far**


At SNHU, you'll have the option to work remotely in the following states: Alabama, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Indiana, Iowa, Kansas, Kentucky, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Mississippi, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Mexico, North Carolina, North Dakota, Ohio, Oklahoma, South Carolina, South Dakota, Tennessee, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, West Virginia, Wisconsin and Wyoming.


We ask that our remote employees have access to a reliable internet connection and a dedicated, properly equipped workspace that is free of distractions. Employees must reside in, and work from, one of the above approved states.


**The opportunity**


The Service Desk Operations Manager is a senior leader responsible for end\-to\-end IT Service Desk operations, ensuring consistent, high\-quality service delivery through internal teams and managed service partners.


In this role, you will own contractual service\-level performance, reporting and analytics, incident management, including coordination of major incident response, and monitoring of operational process execution. You will serve as a strategic leader and a hands\-on operational manager. Additionally, you will oversee technical platform requirements, testing, and delivery for the IT Service Desk team.


You will ensure service desk and business operations functions, including incident management, service requests, and support services, are delivered in alignment with service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and customer experience expectations. You will also drive continuous improvements through process optimization and data\-driven decision\-making. You will report to the Assistant Vice President ITS Service Desk \& Support Operations. \#LI\-Remote


**What you'll do:**


**Leadership \& Service Desk Operations**


* Lead, coach, and develop a team of service desk professionals, driving accountability, performance, and engagement
* Own day\-to\-day operations, including queue health, ticket management, prioritization, and workload balancing
* Be an a hands\-on leader, actively engaging in escalations, incident response, and operational decision\-making

**Contractual Service Level Management**


* Own and govern Service Level Management (SLM) processes for the managed service partner and internal operations
* Monitor SLA/KPI performance (response, resolution, backlog, CSAT) and drive corrective actions to meet established contractual obligations
* Drive operational adjustments, process changes, and prioritization decisions to consistently meet or exceed service targets

**Reporting \& Analytics**


* Develop and maintain operational dashboards and reporting frameworks leveraging ServiceNow, Five9, and related tools with strong collaboration with Platform Owners to align Service Desk requirements and tool capabilities
* Translate data into insights that inform staffing, service design, and operational improvements
* Analyze trends in volume, SLA adherence, incident patterns, and customer feedback to proactively manage performance
* Establish a strong data\-driven operating model, enabling leadership visibility into service health and risks
* Deliver regular reporting to leadership on performance outcomes, trends, and improvement opportunities

**Incident Control \& Escalation Management**


* Provide leadership oversight for incident management, escalation handling, and major incident response
* Be a senior escalation point to ensure timely restoration and communication during service disruptions
* Ensure adherence to incident prioritization, routing, and escalation standards aligned to ITIL practices
* Oversee operational controls related to ticket flow, backlog management, and queue governance

**Process Execution Monitoring \& Optimization**


* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across Service Desk operations
* Serve as Process Repository Owner, ensuring documentation standards, governance, and lifecycle management
* Monitor process execution and adherence, ensuring consistency across Service Desk operations
* Identify inefficiencies and drive process optimization and standardization
* Establish and enforce change control and communication practices for process updates

**Partnerships**


* Maintain an operational leadership role in management of the IT Service Desk managed services provider
* Partner closely with Service Experience Owners to translate quality insights into process, technology, and training improvements
* Partner with Knowledge Enablement to ensure training programs align to operational needs, performance trends, and service changes
* Partner with Platform and Process Owners to align engagement and interaction in Service Desk escalation processes
* Integrate training strategies with quality findings, process updates, and new technology implementations
* Other responsibilities as assigned

**What we're looking for:**


* 10 years of relevant experience in business process ownership, documenting, executing or automating
* 1 year of experience leading teams and operational functions in a complex service environment
* Advanced knowledge of service workflows, and support models
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field or equivalent of experience in lieu of degree
* Experience managing service delivery in large, complex environments, including managed service

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

**About the Role**
------------------



Sales Strategy \& Operations at Motive drives the strategy, execution, and scale of Motive's revenue growth. Our work is cross\-functional and touches nearly every part of the business.



We are looking for a Sales Strategy \& Operations Manager to support our Strategic segment — the largest and most complex fleets in our market, where a single account can represent millions in ARR and a multi\-year, multi\-product relationship. This is our highest\-stakes book of business, and the operating rigor behind it has to match the size of the prize.



We are looking for someone who will bring innovation, experience, and a fresh perspective to our team. Your ability to think strategically, adapt quickly, and get things done will earn credibility with all levels of the organization. Our mandate is to make the sales motion run more effectively, efficiently, and ultimately drive higher productivity. This role will bring a data driven perspective to forecasting, pipeline generation and management, territory design, and other sales metrics. You will collaborate closely with Strategic Sales Leadership, the Enterprise Sales Operations team, and the broader Go\-to\-Market organization, and will direct analytical support from our Strategy \& Operations team in Pakistan.


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Serve as the primary sales operations business partner to Strategic Sales Leadership and their Directors of Strategic Accounts
* Own the weekly, monthly, and quarterly business cadences for the segment — forecast calls, pipeline inspection, QBRs — and escalate deviations from goals and expectations
* Pinpoint the drivers of performance in a low\-volume, high\-value motion and lead initiatives to increase win rates, deal velocity, and multi\-product attach

**Job Title:** Marketplace Operations Manager II


**Job Location (Remote):** Remote, USA

 **About the Company**


Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high\-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting\-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board\-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com.

**About the Role**
------------------


We're looking for a Marketplace Operations Manager II to own visit delivery for a defined set of Wheel's client programs. This is an operator's role for someone who wants day\-to\-day ownership of critical business outcomes \- and can carry that accountability even when some levers live with peer functions. You'll take on the complex, ambiguous problems that come with scaling a fast\-growing telehealth marketplace \- from stabilizing a roster through demand volatility, to leading cross\-functional projects that shape how Marketplace Operations scales next.


You will own the visit delivery SLA commitments, program\-level consult cost performance, and the roster health for your clients. Separate functions on the team own overall clinician supply forecasting, clinician performance management, and scheduling \- freeing you up to optimize their use within your programs.


This is a role for someone who wants to run marketplace operations for key clients end\-to\-end: launching and configuring new client programs, writing the operational playbooks your programs run on, and deploying incentive spend within guardrails \- while trusting peer functions to own adjacent responsibilities in order for you to maintain a singular, maniacal focus on client performance.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Program Performance and Delivery**


	+ Own marketplace performance outcomes (contractual and otherwise) for your assigned client programs: SLA attainment, program\-level clinician pay cost, and roster/staffing health.
	+ Own roster composition and staffing strategy for your programs, building and adjusting rosters to ensure SLA through client growth, churn, and short\-term volatility.
	+ Own operational data analytics and reporting for your programs \- pulling and interrogating utilization, breach\-pattern, and profitability data yourself and turning it into recommendations and actions
	+ Own the operating rhythm and upward performance visibility for your programs: recurring performance reviews of SLA, utilization, and cost that turns into actions.
	+ Partner with the Capacity Planner to understand near\-term volatility and how it may affect client demand (ie demand surges, modality changes, etc) and own the operational response for your programs (escalation thresholds, incentive levers, roster mix) to keep the program on track.**Cost and Incentives**


	+ Optimize program\-level clinician pay cost and deploy consult incentive spend within a defined budget.
	+ Own the cost plan for your programs and be accountable to variance \- partner with the Director of Marketplace on expected cost\-per\-consult, and keep your lever costs calibrated so you know how to deploy your incentives appropriately.**Real\-Time Response and Agent Oversight**


	+ Author the real\-time escalation and response playbook your programs run on: thresholds, approved corrective actions, escalation triggers. Real\-time monitoring and AI agents execute against the playbook you write, and you refine how they act on your programs as their capabilities grow.
	+ Review how the agents act on your programs \- audit their decisions for quality, catch policy drift or mistakes early, and feed corrections back into the playbook and the agent logic. You're the human\-in\-the\-loop that keeps automated responses trustworthy on your book.
	+ Partner with clinician management peers to relay clinician performance observations that impact your programs and to identify roster improvements that will drive your client performance.**Client Launches and Partnership**


	+ Partner with Customer Success as the operational counterpart on the client's commercial relationship \- supporting quarterly business reviews and the real\-world story behind client performance.
	+ Own launch supply\-readiness with Provider Operations and the Capacity Planner \- ensuring clinicians are credentialed, licensed, and activated in the right states, at the volume the program needs, before go\-live.
	+ Lead new\-client implementation \- configuration and setup \- as part of cross functional onboarding teams, and own expansions for programs you already run.
	+ Support strategic projects across Marketplace Operations as they arise.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* An operator with experience working in fast\-paced, high\-demand environments \- someone who digs into the details to find root cause, spots broken or inefficient processes, and builds the fix rather than just flagging the problem.
* Experience owning end\-to\-end operational performance in a marketplace, logistics, or two\-sided platform environment (delivery, rideshare, staffing, workforce management) \- direct accountability for SLA, throughput, or cost.
* Strategic thinker who connects day\-to\-day program performance to the bigger picture \- you can zoom out from a single roster or escalation to spot the pattern worth fixing structurally, and zoom back in to execute it.
* A strong cross\-functional partner and team player \- you know how to work through peer teams and different personalities to drive your program

jobs.title: Data Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Stevenson School is a PK\-12 co\-educational, college\-preparatory, boarding and day school with enrollment of 750 students on two campuses in beautiful Central Coast California. The Upper Division campus (Grades 9\-12\) is located in Pebble Beach. The Lower/Middle Campus (Grades PK\-8\) is in nearby Carmel\-by\-the\-Sea. Stevenson is a mission driven school that aims to help students shape joyful lives while instilling a passion for learning and achievement to prepare them for success in school and beyond.

***Stevenson School is seeking a Data Operations Manager***. This position reports to our *Director of Data Operations* and will oversee the technical platforms, workflows, and data structures that power clear, accurate, and timely communications across the school community. Operating within the Office of the Chief Information Officer, this role serves as the primary technical operator for Slate, Stevenson’s internal information system, translating communication needs into dynamic digital workflows, managing audience segmentation, and building repeatable systems for recurring and event\-based communications. This position is remote, with occasional travel to the School’s Pebble Beach and Carmel campuses (3 to 4 visits per year).

**Responsibilities**

*Slate Platform \& Workflow Operations*

* Design, build, test, schedule, and distribute mass communications, dynamic forms, and event portals in Slate.
* Develop recipient lists, queries, and audience segments using student, parent, and household data.
* Standardize recurring communication workflows and email templates to ensure operational sustainability.
* Document processes and establish standardized practices to make communications repeatable year\-over\-year.
* Partner with the Data Operations team to maintain data quality and enforce institutional business rules.

*Cross\-Departmental \& Event Communications*

* Partner with academic division heads, Admissions, Advancement, College Counseling, Athletics, and Student Life to coordinate communication schedules and reduce message overlap.
* Develop and maintain a centralized annual communications calendar.
* Oversee technical production and distribution for major publications, including weekly and monthly e\-newsletters.
* Manage technical logistics for major school events (e.g., Back\-to\-School Night, Family Weekend, Graduation), including invitations, registration tracking, and automated reminders.

*Marketing \& Communications Collaboration*

* Serve as the technical execution partner to Marketing \& Communications (MarCom), turning approved content into responsive email layouts and digital interfaces.
* Ensure Slate\-based portals, emails, and forms reflect visual standards, brand identity, and accessibility guidelines.
* Manage technical setup, audience targeting, quality testing, and distribution while MarCom maintains editorial ownership.

*Data Integrity \& Process Optimization*

* Analyze communication engagement metrics to evaluate delivery effectiveness and recommend system improvements.
* Identify opportunities to streamline complex processes, eliminate administrative bottlenecks, and optimize data usage.
* Maintain strict standards surrounding student and family data privacy.

 **Required Qualifications**

* Exceptional organizational, project management, and multi\-stakeholder coordination skills.
* High attention to detail regarding scheduling, dates, recipient lists, and sensitive student/family data.
* Strong written communication, editing, and proofreading abilities.
* Uncompromising discretion when handling confidential record systems.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining strong collaborative ties.
* Background in independent schools, higher education, nonprofits, or complex data operations environments is highly valuable.

 **Technical Qualifications**

* **Enterprise CRM/SIS Expertise:** Hands\-on experience with Slate by Technolutions (queries, communications, forms, portals, and automated workflows) or comparable systems.
* **Web \& Layout Technologies:** Proficiency with HTML and CSS for building responsive email templates and web interfaces.
* **Dynamic Scripting:** Experience using Liquid markup or similar templating languages for personalized content delivery.
* **Database \& Querying:** Solid understanding of relational databases, SQL concepts, conditional logic, and audience segmentation.
* **Quality Assurance:** Skill in testing and troubleshooting communications across various devices, operating systems, and email clients.

  

The salary range for this position is $70,000 to $80,0000, commensurate with experience. In addition to competitive salary Stevenson offers a substantial benefits package including retirement plan contributions, a choice of Anthem medical plans with premium coverage provided by the School, vision and dental group plans and support of ongoing professional development. Stevenson offers housing assistance and fuel stipends for eligible employees. Meals are provided throughout the day when school is in session.


In keeping with Stevenson’s core values, we seek candidates who demonstrate a commitment to equity and inclusion. Candidates from underrepresented backgrounds are encouraged to apply.


Stevenson is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law.


Interested candidates are invited to use the link provided to submit a resume and cover letter to the People Operations team at Stevenson School.

If you've felt boxed in by a single\-team assignment and want the variety and influence that comes with managing the work itself rather than one team's slice of it, this role is built for exactly that.



We're looking for an experienced, portfolio\-minded project manager who can bring order to cross\-team dependencies, flex across multiple initiatives at once, and deliver executive\-ready updates to business sponsors and technology leaders alike.


**What We Can Offer You**


* Estimated Salary: $125,000 \- $145,000, plus annual bonus opportunity

* Work\-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays — see our benefits and perks page
* Applicants must not now, nor at any point in the future, require employment sponsorship

jobs.title: Quarterly Planning and Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
**Job Description:**

**The Role:**

JD Power’s Analytics team of over 200 professionals uses a hybrid, customized version of SAFe (scaled agile framework) to coordinate, execute and measure quarterly product development plans through planned cycles (program increments) to deliver value faster and more predictably. This role is responsible for the execution and ongoing optimization of that approach across sets of analytics professionals including data scientists, AI engineers, ML engineers, data engineers, software engineers, data insights analysts, data visualization and QA analysts, and data strategists. You will also interface heavily with partner teams in product and technology organizations as we move towards more consistent approaches across these teams. This is a high\-intensity, high\-visibility execution role involving the creation of net\-new data\-driven, AI\- and ML\-based products with our diverse set of automotive data assets.  



The role also evaluates, reports and conducts retrospectives on Analytics team operational KPIs for several of our major product areas involving our most complex, real\-time data sets that have high customer expectations and very fast customer response times. These metrics involve product quality, throughput, model accuracy and other identifiers. You will partner with Analytics leaders to identify, root cause and improve business performance, and evaluate and measure the impact of use of AI in our development teams.  



This role sits within the Transformation Office, the enterprise function responsible for orchestrating the programs and initiatives that underpin our three\-year strategy. In this capacity, you will be a dedicated execution partner to our CDAO, embedded in the work that matters most and positioned to grow alongside it.  



**The Impact You Will Have in This Role:**

Data and analytics are core to what JD Power sells and how we operate, particularly as our data assets and product development roadmaps have grown more complex and connected across multiple data sources. Your involvement in this position will ensure clarity of product development purpose and enable teams to effectively plan and ultimately own their development commitments. The Project Manager in this role is not a coordinator. You are voice of the Analytics organization in relation to what we shipped, what we will ship, how confident we are in doing so, and whether our quality, throughput and accuracy are performing to expectations.  



**What You’ll Be Doing in This Role:**

· Facilitate program increment quarterly planning events to align teams on a shared mission, objectives and delivery commitments each quarter. Lead inspect \& adapt workshops, facilitating quantitative and qualitative retrospectives and executing on improvement ideas


· Track and communicate metrics like completion rates, program predictability, to provide transparency and drive continuous improvement


· Leading end\-to\-end program delivery by coordinating across multiple teams and functions, adapting to methodologies as needed including Agile, hybrid, and data platform\-specific workflows


· Building, maintaining, and owning the committed project plan and schedule, distinct from the product roadmap, and ensuring milestones are met with transparency and rigor


· Drive adoption and maturity of product planning practices across the organization


· Applying a hybrid toolkit – technical project management, agile delivery, and business analysis to address the specific needs of each workstream


· Bring technical project management expertise to address engineering and AI challenges, working closely with technical leads and data scientists to monitor development progress and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical execution.


· Partner with Analytics leaders to set annual KPI objectives for year\-on\-year improvements. Proactively measure and report out on those KPIs and partner with technical teams to uncover root causes, implement retrospective actions and identify risks and countermeasures  



**What You Bring**

· 5\-8 years of project management experience


· Highly accountable, you own your commitments, follow through without being chased, and hold others to the same standard


· A self\-starter who can operate with limited direction, identify what needs to happen next, and move without waiting to be told


· Strong communication skills, able to distill complex program status into clear, concise updates for leadership audiences, both written and verbal


· Experience in technology\-centric environments (software development, IT, or data) with a history of bridging business objectives and technical execution


· Proficiency in SAFe a plus. Proficiency in both Agile and Waterfall methodologies, generally speaking; experience with Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, or similar SDLC and PM tools


· Demonstrated experience applying AI tools to program and project management workflows, and a track record of proactively exploring and adopting emerging AI capabilities to improve team productivity and decision\-making


· Strong RAID discipline, schedule management, budget oversight, and the instinct to track details without losing sight of the bigger picture.


· Comfortable managing multiple workstreams concurrently in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment


· Bachelor's degree preferred; PMP certification a plus


· North American based, with availability to work across a distributed global team.  



This position has a starting salary range of **$75,000 – $90,000 USD / 75,000 – 123,000 CAD** per year. This is the range we reasonably and in good faith expect to pay for the role at the time of posting. An employee’s pay within the range is determined by a number of factors, including relevant skills, education, qualifications, experience, performance, business or organizational needs, and geographic location.

We listen before we take action. This means understanding a variety of perspectives and holding ourselves to a higher standard of accountability.

**Job Description:**

**About the Position**  

The Advising Operations Coordinator role at The Chicago School oversees operational processes and systems related to student advising. This is an operations support role with the university's Student Advising team. Success in this role includes effective collaboration with students, faculty, staff, academic
  

departments, and Student Support Counselors to deliver a strong advising experience to students. Key responsibilities include managing advising\-related data, department schedules, enrollment processes, reporting, and system accuracy.  

  



**This is a remote role. The Advising Operations Coordinator will report to the Assistant Director of Advising Operations and will be assigned management of the advising\-related operations of a subset of The Chicago School's academic departments. Domestic travel and work outside of standard business hours will be required to support key activities and events.**

  

**Principal Duties**  

**Information Management**

* Centrally track advising\-related data and ensure that data are accessible, accurate, and up to date.
* Track student information related to general academic progress, dissertation progress and coordination, administrative withdrawals, degree audits, faculty advisor assignments, and cross\-campus enrollment.
* Review commencement eligibility, residency, study abroad, and other academic needs to ensure that students remain on track toward graduation.
* Manage implementation of internal articulation agreements for students moving between academic programs at The Chicago School.

**Schedule Management**

* Lead course scheduling to meet student needs, considering average credit hours, class sizes, course sequences, breaks in enrollment, and time to graduation.

* Participate in enrollment meetings and term\-preparation activities to review course offerings, enrollment, instructor assignments, and other registration\-related needs.
* Review course schedules and enrollment data to identify necessary updates, including deactivating courses, assigning TBA instructors, reviewing courses with low or no enrollment, and making other scheduling adjustments as needed.

* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* 1\-2 years of administrative or higher education experience.
* Bachelor's degree.

* Excellent interpersonal skills.
* Strong time management and prioritization skills.
* Highly organized and attentive to detail.
* Ability to manage projects independently.

* Experience with CampusVue/Campus Nexus or similar student information systems, including course scheduling, enrollment management, data review, and report generation.

### **About the role:**



The Customer Enablement Manager (CEM) ensures hospital administrators and staff are ready to use PetDesk solutions from go\-live onward, training them to apply best practices, use key reporting and admin tools, and work confidently in the product day\-to\-day.



This is fundamentally a build\-first role. Reporting to the Director of Customer Success, the CEM partners with Project Managers, Build, Customer Success, Support, and Product to keep training grounded in what customers actually need; but the real impact comes from the curriculum and content they design \- a quality that holds up long after any single session ends.



### **Apply if you’re excited to:**


* Design, build, and maintain training content and curricula across every format, 1:1, small group, webinar, and asynchronous/Academy, keeping materials current as PetDesk's products and each customer's toolset evolve
* Deliver role\-specific training for practice administrators, front and back office staff, DVMs, and other audiences, teaching PetDesk best practices and how other solutions' workflows fit with PetDesk so customers can apply them confidently day to day
* Partner with Project Managers and Build teams to understand high\-complexity implementations, including configuration, timelines, priorities, and build in just\-in\-time training accordingly
* Serve as a feedback loop to both Implementation and Customer Success teams, highlighting process, skill, or learning gaps that may need extra training or support, and identifying accounts whose needs may exceed the standard scope
* Partner with CS, Support, and Product to align on customer needs, share training insights, and support handoffs across the customer journey. Gather customer feedback to improve training content and delivery, and fill gaps in the Knowledge Base
* Facilitate live and virtual sessions for customers, adapting pace and approach so participants at any technical comfort level can ask questions and practice new workflows
* Use AI to work more efficiently, personalize training, and keep improving how customers get educated
### **About you:**

* Portfolio required, showing sample job aids and live or e\-learning training content
* Instructional design and curriculum development experience required; this is a build\-first role, not facilitation\-only. Should include experience storyboarding and building microlearning and e\-learning content, with clear objectives, knowledge checks, and/or certifications for asynchronous and Academy\-style learning
* 2\+ years in training, onboarding, customer education, or similar customer\-facing enablement work, ideally in healthcare or SaaS
* Experience designing and delivering role\-specific training for different audiences, administrators, front\- and back\-office staff — grounded in adult\-learning principles that make complex concepts practical and approachable
* Strong oral and written communication skills, with experience facilitating live training sessions, both virtual and in person, and leading confident interactions with customers and internal stakeholders
* Empathy, patience, and adaptability when working with people across a wide range of technical comfort levels
* Quick to learn new software workflows and best practices, and confident applying them
* Veterinary clinic or SaaS customer training experience preferred

### **What success looks like:**


* Practice administrators and staff reach confidence in their specific, role\-relevant workflows by go\-live, and both customers and internal partners trust that staff are prepared to perform critical workflows independently from Day 1
* Customers understand and can independently apply PetDesk best practices following training that's tailored to their specific implementation, roles, workflows, and configuration — never one\-size\-fits\-all
* Training completion and attendance consistently meet targets across relevant customer roles
* Low volume of basic "how\-to" support tickets in the weeks immediately following go\-live
* Training and enablement feedback scores consistently meet or exceed expectations
* Training content and enablement materials are consistently up\-to\-date, high\-quality, and reflective of current product functionality and best practices across the full customer lifecycle, not just at launch
* Knowledge Base content is accurate, accessible, and actively used by customers as a self\-serve resource
* CS, Support, and Product consistently receive timely, relevant input from training insights, supporting smoother handoffs and alignment across the customer journey
### **Benefits \& Perks:**


* Medical coverage for employees and dependents (80\-90% covered by employer)
* Employer HSA contribution with HDHP
* 401(k) match up to 3\.5%
* Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
* Dental \& Vision coverage available
* Basic Life and AD\&D Insurance
* Short and Long Term Disability
* Flexible Time Off \& 12 Paid Annual Holidays
* Paid Parental Leave
* Pawternity Leave, Financial Pet Adoption Support \& Subsidized Pet Insurance
* $250 Annual Stipend for Learning and Development

jobs.description:
**ABOUT US**
------------


At Sprinter Health, our mission is to dramatically expand access to healthcare by reimagining the patient experience—delivered at home and powered by technology for scale.


We’re building the technology and clinical services platform to make preventive, connected healthcare accessible for everyone in the US. We deliver hybrid care (in\-home \+ virtual) backed by data products across 15\+ states, serving 60%\+ of the US population through major health plans and systems. With 1M\+ patients and 92\+ NPS, we’re rapidly scaling our impact. Our team of technologists, clinicians, and operators is backed by investors including a16z, General Catalyst, GV, and Accel.


We have a rapidly growing team of visionary leaders who are passionate about increasing access to care, lowering healthcare costs, and improving outcomes for patients.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**
------------------


We are growing rapidly and are looking for a Clinical Operations Liaison to support our clinical leaders as we scale our field operations and clinical teams. You’ll be the connective thread between our NPs and Sprinters (our clinician field staff) and the operational systems that keep them paid, trained, and compliant — handling workforce tracking, payroll compliance follow\-up, documentation review, and reporting so clinical leadership can stay focused on patient care, clinical support, and clinical oversight.


We’re not just looking for someone to execute a checklist. As we scale, we want someone who notices where a workflow is clunky, a tracker is out of date, or a process could run smoother — and speaks up about it. You’ll have real opportunities to help shape how these processes evolve.


This is a **remote full\-time position**. This role reports to the Director of Quality \& Training.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**
------------------------

### **Workforce \& Payroll Compliance**

* Serve as the day\-to\-day point of contact for NPs and Sprinters on timesheet, mileage, and documentation questions
* Follow up with field employees on timesheet submissions, PTO entries and approval, and sick time to ensure accuracy before each payroll close
* Validate weekly mileage and hours are submitted in accordance with policy and protocols
* Review and abstract supporting documentation for mileage and time submissions
* Approve expenses within set parameters
* Data pulls and tracking for peer audits, bonus incentives
* Deliver a weekly exception report to each manager — escalations only, with full documentation
* Other duties as assigned

### **Workforce Operations \& Reporting**

* Maintain clinical employee attendance, call\-off, and workforce planning trackers

* Maintain dashboards, trackers, and workforce metrics
* Other duties as assigned

### **Escalation \& Program Support**

* Manage administrative escalation trackers and ensure timely follow\-up on open items
* Route non\-clinical operational issues to appropriate teams
* Maintain SOPs, workflows, and operational documentation
* Track project milestones and action items; support new workflow launches as directed by the In\-Home Director

### **Compliance \& Quality**

* Participate in internal audits; identify documentation gaps and recommend process improvements
* Flag recurring issues or inefficiencies in existing workflows and propose fixes to your manager
* Maintain confidentiality and adhere to all HIPAA and compliance standards

**YOU’LL LOVE THIS JOB IF**
---------------------------

* You take pride in accuracy and integrity, finding satisfaction in getting every detail right
* You’re motivated by mission as much as metrics — knowing your work directly supports better access to preventive and chronic care for patients nationwide
* You thrive in a tech\-forward, fast\-growing environment where innovation and continuous improvement are part of the daily rhythm
* You enjoy working independently in a remote setting while staying connected to a collaborative, purpose\-driven team
* You’re naturally curious, proactive, and eager to contribute feedback and shape evolving processes
* Most of all, you value flexibility, accountability, and being part of a company that’s reimagining how healthcare reaches people where they are

**ABOUT YOU**
-------------


You will thrive at Sprinter Health if you have:

* A desire to work collaboratively with a tight\-knit but quickly growing team across many different areas of the business
* Flexibility, humility, and a sense of humor
* Excitement for working in a fast\-paced, high\-growth environment

**Experience and Skills:**

* 2\+ years in an operations, coordination, or administrative support role
* Experience managing multiple workflows, trackers, or reports simultaneously
* Comfortable working independently and remotely with minimal day\-to\-day direction
* Strong communication and problem\-solving skills
* Proficient in EHR systems and Google tools
* Reliable internet connection and dedicated, secure workspace
* Available to work CST hours

**Preferred:**

* Experience in healthcare operations, medical group administration, or home health/home care
* Familiarity with multi\-state payroll or leave compliance
* Experience supporting a distributed or regional field team
* Prior use of Rippling or a similar HRIS platform

**THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE**
------------------------------

* Disciplinary action or performance management
* Clinical, patient\-facing, or care coordination responsibilities

**TECHNOLOGIES WE USE**
-----------------------

* Slack

**About Avive:**

Avive Solutions, Inc. (https://avive.life) is a growth stage Automated External Defibrillator (AED) company with a connected response system that is rapidly gaining market share. **Job Level:** Individual Contributor

**Work Type:** Hybrid
  
**Job Location:** Pleasanton; San Ramon
  
  

Department Overview
  
  

Gas Engineering is focused on ensuring the safe and reliable flow of natural gas to our customers. As a part of Gas Engineering, the Gas Transmission Engineering and Design group (GTED) focuses on providing the technical direction and design of gas transmission pipeline and facility projects, and supporting the execution of the work in the field. The group also provides technical review and approval of project documentation post construction to ensure company records are updated accurately and reflect the scope of work performed. The Materials Management team within GTED is responsible for supporting project material needs, and ensuring traceable, verifiable, and complete (TVC) records are available for the materials we install per federal code requirements.
  
  

Position Summary
  
  

This Expert Gas Program Manager position provides strategic leadership and oversight for materials traceability and materials management within PG\&E’s Gas Engineering team, supporting both transmission and distribution systems. This role is responsible for ensuring that all gas\-related materials are fully traceable, compliant, and aligned with federal, state, and corporate regulatory requirements.
  
  

This position operates at the intersection of engineering, supply chain, quality, and field execution, driving enterprise\-wide process improvements, strengthening data governance, and ensuring audit readiness. The role also plays a key part in advancing material lifecycle management, improving project visibility, and delivering measurable cost and operational efficiencies.
  
  

**Key Job Duties:**  

Materials Traceability \& Regulatory Compliance
  
* Lead centralized intake and resolution of material traceability inquiries supporting gas transmission and distribution projects.
* Conduct advanced research and documentation retrieval across SAP, vendor databases, and internal systems to validate traceability in accordance with PHMSA and PG\&E standards.
* Ensure all materials are traceable, verifiable, complete, and auditable, supporting safe field execution and public safety.
* Partner with Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA), Supplier Quality Engineering (SQE), manufacturers, and vendors to resolve documentation gaps and validate material quality.
* Drive enhancements to traceability processes, including SAP data entry, logging, and validation controls to improve accuracy and audit readiness.
* Support and lead regulatory audit responses, including CPUC and PHMSA\-related initiatives.


Materials Management \& Process Controls
  
* Lead development and implementation of materials management processes, including material ordering workflows, BOM standardization, and SAP data governance.
* Oversee material tracking systems to provide end\-to\-end visibility into material status, shortages, and project readiness.
* Manage inventory lifecycle activities, including reallocation of surplus materials, resolution of aged inventory, and optimization of material utilization.
* Establish and manage centralized materials intake processes to ensure consistent tracking, accountability, and responsiveness.
* Partner with planning and supply chain teams to proactively mitigate material\-related schedule risks.

* Identify and drive large, organization\-level product initiatives forward that have multiple stakeholders, competing deadlines, multiple dependencies and many moving parts
* Prioritize, assess tradeoffs, propose clear solutions and communicate strategically

### **Minimum Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 7 years of experience in program or project management
* Experience managing cross\-functional projects with shifting requirements, from initial concept and roadmapping through execution and delivery
* Experience working directly with product designers and content designers
* Experience independently managing project timelines, setting priorities, and escalating blockers across multiple workstreams

new_jobs.title: Clinical/Account Management Support Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Candela Corporation is a leading global aesthetic device company with a comprehensive product portfolio and a global distribution footprint. We are the market leader in the development, manufacturing, and distribution of medical and aesthetic laser and light\-based technologies. The Company’s technology enables physicians to provide advanced solutions for a broad range of medical\-aesthetic application including hair removal, wrinkle reduction, tattoo removal, improving the skin’s appearance through the treatment of benign vascular and pigmented lesions, and the treatment of acne, leg veins, scarring and other common indications.


Candela develops products for the global aesthetic market. These products begin as concepts developed by Candela’s world\-class team of scientists and engineers or as acquired or licensed technologies. These programs are supported by Candela’s global business unit, clinical, regulatory, and quality teams and are managed through our Product Development Process (PDP) and Quality Management System (QMS).


The Company’s headquarters are in Marlborough, Massachusetts, US, with an additional R\&D facility in Yokneam, Israel and commercial locations across Asia Pacific, and Europe. Products are sold direct in 18 countries worldwide and through distributors in over 60 others and are supported by field sales, field service, clinical education and marketing organizations.

**General****Summary**


We are seeking a dynamic, highly skilled **Clinical/Account Management Support Specialist** to join our team in a hybrid role that blends clinical expertise, training, customer care, technical support and client relations responsibilities. The ideal candidate will serve as a key liaison between clinical teams, clients, and user groups, ensuring high standards of care while fostering a collaborative, user\-centered environment with focus on our Glace device. As a Clinical/Account Management Support Specialist, you will help facilitate clinical processes, share best practices, and provide support for the success of both internal teams and client relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Work together with Senior Clinical Team Lead and Customer Success to drive strategy, execution and continuous improvement across the Glace brand.
* Provide clinical support to ensure optimal patient care and safety in line with industry’s best practices and regulatory requirements.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships, ensuring their needs are understood and addressed in a timely and effective manner.
* Facilitate customer care initiatives, including user support, troubleshooting with Tech Support NA, and resolution of clinical\-related concerns.
* Serve as a point of contact for client escalations, ensuring clear communication and swift problem\-solving.
* Collaborate with clients to tailor clinical solutions to their specific needs and expectations.
* Work cross\-functionally support post\-sales activities and customer utilization efforts to ensure long term customer success.
* Coordinate user groups, customer journey and onboarding, ensuring active customer engagement and sharing of clinical insights and best practices.
* Share clinical knowledge and promote best practices to improve the overall user experience and client satisfaction.

 **Qualifications**

**Experience:**

* 2\+ years of relevant clinical or healthcare experience
* Exposure to clinical procedures, medical devices and patient care a plus
* Experience providing presentations, training and clinical document helpful but not required
* Proven track record of improving clinical outcomes and customer satisfaction
* Experience in customer care or client\-facing roles is highly desirable

 **Key Competencies**

* Proactive, self\-starter who thrives in hybrid, flexible working environments
* Strong clinical knowledge and ability to interpret and apply industry best practices
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport with clients and teams
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution skills, especially in customer\-facing situations
* Customer\-Centric mindset
* Clinical depth \& problem solving
